scope.question: Which algorithm should be the first guest-linked asymmetric verification experiment?
scope.ed25519Terminology: Use the fully specified JOSE alg value Ed25519. EdDSA is retained only when describing Pulse's existing unpublished vocabulary or legacy RFC 8037 material.

facts: RS256 is registered as Recommended.
ES256 is registered as Recommended+.
Ed25519 is registered as Optional.
EdDSA is registered as Deprecated.
RS256 is RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256 and requires RSA keys of at least 2048 bits.
ES256 is ECDSA over P-256 with SHA-256.
An ES256 JWS signature is the fixed 64-byte concatenation of the 32-byte big-endian R and S values.
Ed25519 is the fully specified JOSE algorithm identifier for Ed25519 signatures.
The polymorphic EdDSA algorithm identifier is deprecated.
Existing Ed25519 key representations remain unchanged.
An Ed25519 public key is 32 bytes.
An Ed25519 signature is 64 bytes.
Ed25519 signing is deterministic and uses SHA-512 internally.
The RFC supplies deterministic test vectors and verification validation rules.
OKP JWK represents Ed25519 public keys with crv Ed25519 and a base64url-encoded x member.
The RFC includes JOSE signing and verification examples using the legacy EdDSA identifier.
Deterministic generation of the ECDSA per-message secret can avoid dependence on fresh randomness during signing.
The RFC supplies deterministic ECDSA test vectors.
OpenID Providers are generally required to support RS256 for ID Token signing.
RS256 therefore remains a high-value external identity-provider compatibility algorithm.
Amazon Cognito signs user-pool JWTs with RS256.
Cognito documents 2048-bit RSA signing keys.
Node Web Crypto documents ECDSA, RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5, and Ed25519 key import and verification.
Node marks Ed25519 stable in current releases and records its earlier introduction.
Fastly JavaScript documents verify support for RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 and HMAC.
The current verify documentation does not list ECDSA or Ed25519.
Fastly JavaScript documents RSA, HMAC, and ECDSA key import.
The current importKey documentation does not list Ed25519.
Chrome 137 added Ed25519 to Web Crypto.
Firefox 129 added Web Crypto Ed25519 signing, verification, generation, import, and export.
Safari 17 added Ed25519 support to Web Crypto.
The secure-curves Web Crypto proposal defines Ed25519 operations.
The proposal is not a W3C standard and describes the algorithms as optional.
Web Cryptography defines ECDSA and RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 operations, including key import and verification.
P-256 is a named curve recognized by the Web Cryptography specification.
The p256 crate supports no_std builds and P-256 ECDSA with SHA-256.
The project is dual licensed Apache-2.0 OR MIT.
The project documents independent-audit and constant-time review limitations.
The rsa crate is a portable pure-Rust implementation with PKCS#1 v1.5 verification.
The project is dual licensed Apache-2.0 OR MIT.
The implementation relies on large-integer machinery and carries explicit security review caveats.
ed25519-dalek can be built without the standard library when default features are disabled.
The project is dual licensed Apache-2.0 OR MIT.
The project provides strict verification APIs and documents verification validation subtleties.
Espressif guidance in February 2025 stated that the default ESP-IDF Mbed TLS configuration did not support EdDSA.
The guidance recommended ECDSA-256 or RSA-3072 for the reported ESP32-C6 use case.
Acceleration availability depends on the ESP32 family and configuration.
ESP-IDF 6.0 moved to Mbed TLS 4.x and a PSA-first integration.
An ESP-IDF major-version upgrade alone does not prove an Ed25519 realization for an unpinned ESP32 family and build.

native-wasm.label: Native Wasm
native-wasm.currentPulseProof: HS256 guest-source in Node Native and Fastly Native/Viceroy cells; asymmetric guest linking is not implemented

esp32.label: ESP32

ES256.candidate: RustCrypto p256 with a deliberately minimal feature set

RS256.candidate: RustCrypto rsa with PKCS#1 v1.5 verification and a pinned large-integer backend

Ed25519.candidate: ed25519-dalek with default features disabled and a pinned curve backend
